text:
Maya Chen: @Jordan @Priya need quick approval — Astra AI (pilot -> enterprise) wants a flex-seat addendum. Sales proposes 20% credit off subscription face for months 1-3, monthly true-up, net30 invoices. They want the addendum signed by EOM.
Jordan Patel: can you post expected ARR/MRR and rationale for 20%? how sticky is the seat growth?
Maya Chen: ARR if committed seats 120 -> $360k ARR. MRR ramp by month: $10k / $40k / $90k. They're price sensitive; risk they switch if we don't concede. They've committed to a 12-month SOW.
Jordan Patel: finance POV — 20% looks high. propose either 15% for first 2 months + 10% month 3, or 18% flat for 3 months. need GL treatment and margin impact. Also need Sofia signoff if credit > 15%.
Luca Rossi: RevOps - we can support monthly true-up + seat delta tracking. Billing will use code `ASTRA-FLEX` and a subscription add-on line. initial reconciliation will be manual for first 2 cycles, then automated.
Priya Nair: Legal - we'll need a short addendum + amended SOW. cannot accept open-ended indemnities or unconstrained credits. include limit language and a 30-day annual true-up provision. I'll draft a 1-page addendum and flag any unusual liability.
Sofia Vega: I'm OK to sign off up to 18% total credit across the first 3 months IF legal adds revenue protection clause and RevOps confirms seat tracking and reconciliation steps. Otherwise cap at 15%.
Maya Chen: understood. Updated ask: Astra gets 18% across months 1-3, monthly true-up, net30. Priya to draft addendum, Luca to confirm billing flow.
Jordan Patel: finance tentatively approves with Sofia's condition. Maya please route the final addendum + revenue worksheet to deals@redwood.com and cc billing-bot for tracking.
billing-bot: Ticket created: #3129 - Astra Addendum routing to finance. Assigned: Jordan Patel.
Maya Chen: sending draft SOW and revenue estimates to deals@redwood.com now. tagging @Luca for billing code setup. :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: noted in Deal Desk tracker and revenue impact sheet. will update once amendment countersigned and post the final ARR delta.
